title: ADP Consulting - Development Application Fire Engineering Statement, SES Incident Control Centre expansion, 56-58 Knox Street, Goulburn (DA/0242/2425)
jurisdiction: New South Wales, Australia - COMPARATIVE ONLY (not Alberta; NSW code text, not Alberta applicability)

facts.text: Letter 'Development Application (DA) Fire Engineering Statement' for SYD3513 SES ICC expansion, 56-58 Knox Street, Goulburn; dated 31 January 2025; Revision 01.
States the design will meet the NCC Volume One fire safety performance requirements through a combination of fire engineering performance solutions and DtS provisions.

Named performance-based items: a non-required (DtS) fire detection and alarm system for extended travel distances; performance-based separation of openings using toughened glazing or heat-attenuating mesh; performance-based discharge using the existing sloped driveway.
Outstanding non-compliances in the BCA Capability Statement are to be addressed by a DtS-compliant AS 2419.1 hydrant system and fire-rating of external columns within 3 m of the side boundary.
Letter states its view that no significant fire safety design issue would prevent lodging the DA, and that compliance is achievable 'as the design develops'.

limitations: Comparative NSW material: it cannot establish Alberta performance or Alberta applicability.
One-page letter; the BCA Capability Statement and the drawings it cites are not in hand.
The letter's own view is not a finding of compliance and is not treated as one here.
